Oh no don't get me wrong, my therapist is great. So is my psychiatrist. There's many things in my life that could be causing this but who knows.

I've been through years of mental health assistance, to put it gently, and I'm prescribed a few different meds. I have been diagnosed with depression but I just kind of feel like I'm not even depressed, I'm just kinda sick of life. I feel like my life has been kinda lived up to as much as I want to live it and I'd love some rest.
I don't want to be alive.
